title: Ensure repository deletion is limited to specific users
titleZh: 仓库删除受限于特定用户
description: Deferred to a later release: Bitbucket does not expose deletion as a permission of its own, so any verdict would be a restatement of the administrator counts already reported by CIS-1.3.3 and CIS-1.3.7.
remediation: Reduce the number of accounts holding repository or project Admin under Repository settings -> Repository permissions and Project settings -> Project permissions. For repositories that must not be lost, keep an independent backup or mirror, since a deletion by an administrator cannot be prevented by configuration alone.
remediationZh: 在 仓库设置 -> Repository permissions 与 项目设置 -> Project permissions 中收敛持有 Admin 的账号数量。对不可丢失的仓库，应另行保留备份或镜像——管理员删除行为无法仅靠配置阻止。
